name: four_b
intro: A four-stage security lock. Clear all four modules to escape.
manual:
PANEL MANUAL

MODULE 1 - BUTTON
- If the button is red, HOLD it.
- Otherwise, PRESS it.

MODULE 2 - WIRES
Cut exactly one wire:
- If there are more than three wires, cut the SECOND wire.
- Otherwise, cut the LAST wire.

MODULE 3 - LEVERS
Three levers (left, middle, right), each UP or DOWN:
- If all levers are DOWN, pull the LEFT lever.
- If the right lever is UP, pull the RIGHT lever.
- Otherwise, pull the MIDDLE lever.

MODULE 4 - KEYPAD
One symbol glows. Enter its code:
- heart: 2020
- star: 4040
- key: 6060

modules.title: A bundle of wires
modules.observation: Five wires, left to right: red, green, blue, yellow, black.

modules.title: Three levers
modules.observation: The LEFT lever is DOWN, the MIDDLE lever is DOWN, the RIGHT lever is UP.

modules.title: A symbol keypad
modules.observation: A keypad with a glowing KEY symbol above it.
